# Operating context

Analysts at the Trust review incoming episodes daily. Most reports describe ordinary life: deliveries, visitors, tradespeople, tourists photographing the older buildings on Church Lane. The analysts' concern is the small number of episodes that, taken together, suggest preparation for one of the registered risks.

Analysts are reminded that a single observation rarely justifies concern on its own, that ordinary explanations must be recorded before severity is assigned, and that every decision is auditable.
